title: Ecommerce basket line items
description: The description of item(s) that was included in a transaction or purchase.

image_url.description: Image URL for the line item

name.description: Descriptive name of the order line item

quantity.description: Quantity of the order line item

unit_price.description: Unit Price is charged without a decimal place  e.g. $1.5 = 150. Currencies can have different decimals/exponentials,  see Currencies Section for more details.

unit_price_tax.description: Unit Price Tax is charged without a decimal place  e.g. $1.5 = 150. Currencies can have different decimals/exponentials,  see Currencies Section for more details.

discount_amount.description: Discount inclusive of tax. This is charged without a decimal place  e.g. $1.5 = 150. Currencies can have different decimals/exponentials,  see Currencies Section for more details.

total_tax_amount.description: Total tax amount is charged without a decimal place  e.g. $1.5 = 150. Currencies can have different decimals/exponentials,  see Currencies Section for more details.

total_amount.description: Total Amount is charged without a decimal place  e.g. $1.5 = 150. Currencies can have different decimals/exponentials,  see Currencies Section for more details.

sku.description: The stock keeping unit (SKU) for the item.

category.description:
The item category type.
The possible values are:
* DIGITAL_GOODS - Goods that are stored, delivered, and used in their electronic format. This value is not currently supported for API callers that leverage the [PayPal for Commerce Platform](https://www.paypal.com/us/webapps/mpp/commerce-platform) product.
* DIGITAL_GOODS - A tangible item that can be shipped with proof of delivery.
